title: LaterDiscs
description: Adds music discs from later Minecraft versions back into the past, complete with recipes, advancements, and more!
body:
LaterDiscs adds music discs from later Minecraft versions to older versions, letting you enjoy more tunes in your world!

It also adds stonecutter recipes for these new discs and all vanilla discs, making crafting your favorite music easy.

The new Blank Music Disc can be stonecut into any disc, including all vanilla and LaterDiscs Music Discs.

Furthermore, LaterDiscs adds a handful of advancements, some of which are hidden, but all of which have an experience reward!

Perfect for music lovers who want more variety and convenient crafting in their worlds! (also adds secret disc)
